ORAL ORDER Mr. M. I. Mansuri, learned advocate states that he has received instructions to appear for and on behalf of the respondent no.2 and sought permission to appear on behalf of the respondent no.2.
Permission; as sought for; stands granted.
He shall file his Vakalatnama before the Registry.
Registry shall accept the same.
1. Rule.

Learned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.1-State and learned advocate Mr. M. I. Mansuri waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.2.

sentences.text:
Considering the issue involved in the present application and with consent of the learned advocates appearing for the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/14269/2023 ORDER DATED:
17/08/2023 undefined respective parties as well as considering the fact that the dispute amongst the applicant, complainant and victim has been resolved amicably, this matter is taken up for final disposal forthwith.

3. By way of this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (hereinafter referred to as "the Code"), the applicant has prayed for quashing and setting aside FIR being C.R.No. 11192008200050 of 2020 registered with Bavla Police Station, District Ahmedabad Rural for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(F), 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3,
4, 5(F), 6 and 8 of the POCSO Act; proceedings of POCSO Case No. 24 of 2022 pending before the concerned trial court as well as other consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

entities.text: Bavla Police Station, District Ahmedabad Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the respective parties submitted that during pendency of the criminal proceedings, as referred to above, the the applicant, complainant and victim have amicably settled their issue by way of mutual settlement and pursuant to understanding arrived at, the Complainant and victim have accordingly filed an affidavit, which is on record.

The complainant and victim have categorically stated in their affidavits that dispute is amicably resolved and have no objections if the present proceedings are quashed and there is NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/14269/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/08/2023 undefined no surviving grievance between them.
5. Heard learned advocates for the respective parties.

6. Having heard the learned counsel for the respective parties, considering the facts and circumstances arising out of the present application as well as taking into consideration the decisions rendered in the cases of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr., reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, Madan Mohan Abbot Vs. State of Punjab, reported in (2008) 4 SCC 582, Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr., reported in 2009 (1) GLH 31, Manoj Sharma Vs. State &
Ors., reported in 2009 (1) GLH 190 and Narinder Singh & Ors. Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. reported in 2014 (2) Crime 67 (SC), it appears that further continuation of criminal proceedings in relation to the impugned FIR against the applicant would be unnecessary harassment to the applicant.

sentences.text: It appears that the trial would be futile and further continuance of the proceedings pursuant to the impugned FIR would amount to abuse of process of law and Court and hence, to secure the ends of justice, the impugned FIR and other consequential proceedings are required to be quashed and set aside in exercise of powers conferred under Section 482 of the Code.
7. Resultantly, this application is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R.No. 11192008200050 of 2020 registered with Bavla NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/14269/2023 ORDER DATED:
17/08/2023 undefined Police Station, District Ahmedabad Rural; proceedings of POCSO Case No.
24 of 2022 pending before the concerned trial court as well as other consequential proceedings are hereby quashed and set aside qua the present applicant herein.
Accordingly, Rule is made absolute.
8. If the applicant is behind bar, Jail authority as well as Court concerned shall take necessary steps to release the applicant from the jail if he is not required in any other offence.
